# cloudzero_budgets (Data Source)

Lists all CloudZero Budgets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudzero_budgets" "all" {}

output "budget_names" {
  value = [for b in data.cloudzero_budgets.all.budgets : b.name]
}
```
